description: This file defines the PHP class 'Country' within the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Localisation'. The class provides methods to retrieve country information from a database, including fetching a country by ID, ISO codes, and listing all countries. It is part of the OpenCart project's API documentation.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Model class for handling country data within the localisation module of OpenCart.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves country details by country ID.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode2
methods.description: Retrieves country details by the ISO 2-character code.

methods.name: getCountryByIsoCode3
methods.description: Retrieves country details by the ISO 3-character code.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active countries.
